result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the restaurant content, and several horizontal carousels end abruptly at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section continues underneath the fixed bottom navigation, obscuring its image and likely hiding the restaurant details below it.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay so the final card can be fully viewed above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Horizontal category and restaurant carousels show partially clipped items at the right edge, making the content look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle carousel affordance, spacing, or fade at the edge to communicate that the rows are horizontally scrollable.
